entryRule: Apply Unicode NFKD, lowercase, and keep a-z and 0-9. Use other if the key is empty. Fetch the first four characters (or fewer) plus .json. Follow routes[fullKey] if returned. In every cards response, compare the full card name and return all exact matches. No matching route key or record in a successful response means no exact match in this snapshot. An access failure leaves the result unverified.
